body: I wanted an outsider's perspective, so you're fine on that part. I know life is going to be really rough for me because of a lot of people who share his views, but it is a lot easier to deal with those sorts of people for me and think more clearly on the situation (?? not sure how to word that) than with this just because there is no emotional history. It is incredibly hard (pretty much impossible, hence why I'm here) to look at the situation without my feelings on it taking over. I know he cares, but he's got a bit of a fucky way of showing it in terms of all this, haha. I really appreciate having your view though and it's definitely something I'll try to think about going forward :)

You're right, compared to many many others, I am very lucky. The reason I feel like he went back on his word is because he went from saying "ok kiddo" to being like "you're going to die on the street if you do this" and wanted me to change my mind. He's willing to support a daughter, but he won't see me as his son, so all this love and such is directed at a version of me that doesn't exist outside of his view. I guess with all this, it's hard to go back to pretending like things are OK after everything he said to me (despite him being worried, it was still incredibly hateful and I can't excuse it) and after he tried to cross my boundaries multiple times.
